g.title:
'$'''eval "func_$i() { 
 echo \"Dynamic func $i running in PID \$\$\"
 if (( $i > 1 )), then
 { func_$((i-1)) | while read line, do echo \"[$i] \$line\", done, } &
 wait \$!
 fi
 ' (108 us, 0.01%)

'$'''result=$({ echo "Level 1" 1>&2
( echo "Level 2" | tee >(cat 1>&2) | { read input
( echo "Level 3: $input" | { while read line, do
 ( echo "Level 4: $line" | tr '''a-z''' '''A-Z''' ) &
done
wait, } ) 2>&1 | sed '''s/^/[L3] /''' & { echo "Parallel branch' (770 us, 0.08%)
